title: Speaking – Test 3
p1: How do you get to school every day? (Do you usually travel by car? Why/Why not?)
What did you do last weekend? (Did you do anything last weekend? What?)
Do you think that English will be useful for you in the future? Why/Why not?
How often do you use a computer? (What do you use a computer for?)

p3.title: Journey in a car
task: Your cousin is going on a long journey in a car with her friends. She wants to know what she should bring along on the car journey.
Here are some things that are useful on a car journey.
Talk together about the different things she could bring with her and decide which one is the most important.

p4: Do you like to travel with your parents or your friends? (Why?)
Do you prefer travelling by car or by plane? (Why?)
Have you ever been to a foreign country?
In which places would you like to travel? (Why?)
What is the most interesting place in your country?
